text:
mia: Quick note — new Next starter using LlamaClient shows intermittent 401s during SSR on Vercel when the SDK retries. Repro steps below, anyone seen this?

ashley: yeah saw it locally. looks like token rotation occurs but retry doesn't re-inject auth header. :grimacing:

sam: can you paste a minimal repro?

mia: pasted the relevant server-side snippet here:
```js
export async function getServerSideProps(ctx) {
  const prompt = 'hello';
  // using the SDK wrapper we ship in the starter
  const res = await rwsdk.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/llama-lite', input: prompt });
  return { props: { text: res.output } };
}
```
This fails ~1/10 requests with 401 when deployed on Vercel. Locally it's flaky but reproducible with short-lived tokens.

ashley: SDK currently caches bearer when you init the client; the retry middleware replays the request but uses the cached header. If the token rotated between original attempt and retry we end up sending the old token.

ryan: is this SSR-only or also on Edge runtime?

mia: mostly SSR/Node server. Edge runtimes seem fine because token is read from edge env and doesn't rotate in our test case.

kevin-ml: confirmation: retry path needs to call the auth provider to get a fresh token before replaying. We should add an option like `auth.getToken({ forceRefresh: true })` in the retry hook.

sam: proposed quick patch: in retry middleware before replay do:
```js
if (auth && typeof auth.getToken === 'function') {
  const token = await auth.getToken({ forceRefresh: true });
  req.headers['authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
}
```
That should cover rotations and short TTL tokens.

ashley: sounds right. also need to avoid double-refresh on concurrent retries (thundering herd). Use in-flight promise dedupe in auth provider.

mia: can we add a deterministic test in eval harness to prevent regression? e.g. mock auth provider to return tokenA -> tokenB after first attempt and assert retry used tokenB.

dev-bot: ticket created: INF-4821 "sdk-js: retry should refresh auth token before replay" and linked PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/88

ashley: PR looks good functionally but missing unit/e2e test. I'll add a tiny harness test that simulates short-lived token and asserts no 401 on retry.

mia: I'll update the examples repo to include a reproducible starter: /examples/next-llama-client that demonstrates safe SSR usage + a note in quickstart. Will link PR when ready.

sam: also recommend we add a CI smoke for the starter: run `node examples/next-llama-client/vercel-dev-emulator.js` in CI to surface runtime auth regressions.

ryan: UX docs note — add a callout in the Next quickstart: "If you use SSR with rotating credentials, enable SDK auth refresh or use server-side token helpers." Short snippet and link to INF-4821.

ashley: I'll add the docs patch and bump sdk-js to 0.9.3-beta once tests pass.

mia: leaving reproducer gist here: https://gist.github.com/mia/abcd1234 — contains minimal Next app + failing repro script.

sam: small test note — for harness use `nock` to intercept and assert Authorization header value per attempt. Avoid global fetch overrides.

mia: assigning to @ashley and @sam. I'll draft the changelog blurb and link the starter PR. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

sam: thanks — will follow up with the e2e test PR. :shipit:
